title: Software upgrade
navHint: Install a newer Aquarium release on this server, or roll back. Owner only; admins can look.
unavailable: Software upgrades can't be run from here on this server yet. {detail}
readOnly: You can see this as an admin. Only the owner can upgrade or roll back.
chooseHint: Defaults to the latest. Pick an earlier one if you'd rather wait for a feature to settle. You can skip releases: each upgrade applies everything in between.
footer: Takes about 4–6 minutes. A backup is taken first. The app is unavailable for about 1 minute while services restart; chats and project runs in progress are paused and resume afterwards.
bulletBackup: A backup is taken first; if anything fails, the box restores it automatically.
bulletDowntime: The app is unavailable for about 1 minute during the restart. People signed in now will see it reconnect.
bulletRuns: Chats and project runs in progress pause during the restart and resume afterwards.
bulletDatabase: Rolling back later restores the pre-upgrade backup, database included: changes made after the upgrade would be lost.
bulletRollback: Rolling back restores {tag} and its pre-upgrade backup, database included. Changes made since the upgrade will be lost.
carriesOn: The upgrade runs as its own job on the server, so it carries on if you close this tab.
reconnecting: Reconnecting… the services are restarting. This page picks up again by itself.
failedRolledBack: The previous version and its backup were put back automatically. Nothing else is needed.
failedNotRestored: Putting the previous version back did not finish. Ask the person who looks after the server to run `sudo aquarium status`.
interrupted: The upgrade job stopped without finishing.
rollbackHint: Something not right? Rolling back restores {tag} and its backup (database included). Changes made since the upgrade would be lost.

stepHint.restart: The page disconnects for about a minute here and reconnects by itself
stepHint.restore: Database and settings from before the upgrade
